mechanism_pillars.title: Action-serialization bottleneck and cap=96 truncation on multi-employee plant_canary
mechanism_pillars.summary: Each assigned employee in raw Qwen2.5 <tool_call> JSON consumes 12 characters and 8 BPE tokens, so >=9 assigned employees (101+ tokens) truncates under max_new_tokens=96: 100% of full-roster calls (125/189/349 tokens on easy/medium/hard), 73.9% (133/180) of hard DAgger student-state relabels, and 73.1% (95/130) of Days 1..5 hard SolverPolicy calls.

mechanism_pillars.title: Implicit next-token SFT stopping dilution vs explicit EV-calibrated breakeven stopping
mechanism_pillars.summary: Across 322 daily decision states on TRAIN_SEEDS 108000..108044, 77.6% (250/322) lie below breakeven 1/(1+V_known). Uncalibrated SFT labels 62.7% (252/402) positive including 55 negative-EV states, while raw-8k DAgger r1 had only 159/4,000 accuse targets and relied on implicit 100-165-token continuation targets that failed to override the 4k->8k over-accuse prior (92% accused at 8k, -0.542 +/- 0.214). EV-calibrated breakeven labels 13.4% (43/322) positive with 0 negative-EV commits and 3.0x explicit negative-commit DAgger weight.

mechanism_pillars.title: Lossless sufficient-statistic state vs 4k/8k raw transcript eviction and context shift
mechanism_pillars.summary: Evaluating the same adapter at 4k vs 8k flips DAgger r1 from 85% abstention (-0.101 +/- 0.112, n=41) to 92% premature accusation (-0.542 +/- 0.214, n=50), whereas lossless public-ledger features let CompactLinearDAggerPolicy (+0.1505 [+0.0869, +0.2141] over calibrated BC) and TinyMLPPolicy (+0.8922 [+0.7556, +1.0288] over uncalibrated SFT) retain canary maps across all 21 hard days.
